name: tian-ning-2017-uparse-rdp-warcup-its
description: Zhou Lab fungal ITS OTU processing for the ENIGMA 2017 Pilot Core sediment samples (ReadMe_PilotCoreITSMiseq-171101; Renmao Tian, Daliang Ning, Ying Fu, Daniel J Curtis, Yong Li, Yupeng Fan, Joy D. Van Nostrand, Liyou Wu, Jizhong Zhou). DNA: sediment stored at -80 C, microbial genomic DNA extracted by freeze-grinding (Zhou et al. 1996) and purified with the DNeasy PowerSoil kit (QIAGEN; bead tubes not used). Library: two-step PCR (Wu et al. 2015), first step with the fungal ITS primers ITS7F (GTGARTCATCGARTCTTTG) and ITS4R (TCCTCCGCTTATTGATATGC), which amplify the ITS2 region (gITS7/ITS4; our inference from the primers, the ReadMe says only 'the ITS region'), 12 cycles, second step with phasing primers, 25 cycles; Illumina MiSeq 2 x 251 bp. Processing (IEG Amplicon Sequencing Analysis Pipeline, ASAP 1.3): FastQC 0.11.5; paired ends merged with PEAR 0.9.10 (quality cutoff 20, minimum overlap 40 bp); demultiplexed with QIIME 1.9.1 split_libraries_fastq.py (zero barcode errors, quality trim 20); primers trimmed; dereplicated with USEARCH 9.2.64 fastx_uniques; OTUs clustered with UPARSE (-cluster_otus) at 97% identity, singletons and chimeras removed; OTU table by -usearch_global; representative sequences classified with the RDP Classifier (fungalits_warcup trainset, June 2016) at confidence 0.8; aligned with Clustal Omega and a FastTree phylogeny built. Deliverables: AllDetectedSamples (every sample with detectable ITS, raw counts: loaded in CORAL) and SamplesWithEnoughSequences (the 45 samples with more than 1,000 sequences, rarefied to 1,250 reads: derivable, not loaded). Missing samples had too little DNA or sequencing depth. Protocols: http://www.ou.edu/content/ieg/tools/protocols.html

name: ning-2017-geochip5-ieg-pipeline
description: Zhou Lab GeoChip 5.0 180K functional gene microarray analysis of the ENIGMA 2017 Pilot Core sediment samples (ReadMe_PilotCoreGeoChip-171025-DN; Daliang Ning, Weiling Shi, Ying Fu, Daniel J Curtis, Yong Li, Yupeng Fan, Joy D. Van Nostrand, Liyou Wu, Jizhong Zhou). Metagenomic DNA (freeze-grinding extraction, DNeasy PowerSoil purification) was labeled and hybridized following the IEG protocols (Labeling of microbial community DNA 2015-10-20; Hybridizing sample for 180K 2015-09-04). Negative control samples (water) showed no qualified signal. Raw data were preprocessed with the IEG microarray pipeline (http://ieg.ou.edu/microarray/): spot signals normalized by the mean signal of control spots and then by the sum of all sample spot signals; spots removed when the signal-to-noise ratio was below 2.0 (with a per-slide threshold keeping the detection rate of the thermophilic negative-control probes below 5%), the coefficient of variation above 0.8, or the normalized signal below 100; remaining signals log-transformed and scaled to the same total per sample (file suffix T5S2.log.RA). 49 of the 59 pilot core samples yielded enough qualified labeled DNA. Protocols: http://www.ou.edu/content/ieg/tools/protocols.html
